title: Billy Bassett, a lifetime of Albion.
deck: From cup-winning winger to the chairman’s seat.
body: Billy Bassett was part of Albion’s cup-winning sides before becoming a shareholder, director and chairman. The club’s account of its 1898 film footage notes that his service eventually stretched beyond 50 years.

His story connects the playing field to the survival of the institution. In the early twentieth century, Bassett worked alongside Fred Everiss as Albion faced severe financial trouble. The familiar club name endured because people kept it going between the famous Saturdays.
